# MatchCast

> MatchCast is an iPhone app for football clubs. One phone films the match, puts a live scoreboard and graphics into the picture, and streams it to YouTube or Facebook (one destination at a time) or records it to the phone. Not yet in the App Store.

## What it does

- Scoreboard in the video: score, clock, halves, extra time, penalty shoot-out; eight designs, six positions, four sizes
- Streams to YouTube or Facebook; PRO adds TikTok, Instagram and custom RTMP. One destination at a time
- Records to the phone with the scoreboard in the picture, with or without a stream
- Instant replay in a corner window while the live picture continues, with a caption under it (player, number, club, minute) and a spotlight on a tapped player (PRO)
- Clip studio (PRO): after the match, add a spotlight and a caption to a highlight and export it as a video ready to post
- The spotlight follows one tapped player in one clip. The app does not track the ball and produces no tactics or player statistics
- Automatic highlights: every goal and every marked moment becomes a clip; clips are joined into one reel
- Leagues and cups (PRO): generated schedule, results written into the table, table and bracket as broadcast graphics and as a picture to share. Stored on one phone
- Sponsor logos, sliding text ticker, ad-break slide, prize draw, line-up graphic, scoring from a second phone (PRO)
- Players typed in or read from a photographed team sheet on the device
- Reconnects by itself after a network drop and keeps recording locally meanwhile
- Languages: English, Bosnian, Croatian, Serbian, Slovenian, Macedonian, Albanian

## Limits today

- Live streaming works on iPhone only; Android can record but not stream
- One streaming destination at a time
- Football is the only sport switched on
- A competition is stored on the phone that created it

## Pricing

- Free: streaming to YouTube or Facebook with the scoreboard, score and clock control, recording, players, highlights, match history
- PRO: planned at €6.99 a month or €49.99 a year with a 7-day free trial; the App Store price applies
